text: In 1979 an American film crew [disappears into the Amazon rainforest|trigger|travelling somewhere remote] while making a documentary about cannibal tribes, and the NYU anthropologist Harold Monroe leads a mission to find them. Among the Yacumo and the Ya̧nomamö he finds [the filmmakers' skeletal remains|images|corpses and body parts] at a shrine and trades a tape recorder for their film reels. Back in New York he learns that the director Alan Yates [staged scenes to make his films more exciting|wants|fame and worship], and the footage shows the crew [burning villagers in a hut to fake a massacre|wrong|war and atrocity].
